nodes.title: CRA 2024/2847: free OSS project owes almost nothing legally; commercial distributor is the manufacturer
nodes.summary: Art3(14) steward must be a legal person supporting FOSS intended for commercial activity; Art24 requires only a documented verifiable cybersecurity policy and cooperation with market surveillance (Art14 reporting only if involved in development and only for incidents on steward infra). Art64(10)(b): no administrative fines on stewards. Manufacturers (Art3(13), includes free of charge when in a commercial activity, Art3(22)) face 15M EUR / 2.5% fines, Art14 reporting live 2026-09-11, remaining obligations 2027-12-11 (Art71). Art13(5) makes downstream manufacturers demand SBOM/vuln policy/CVD from us. Commission draft guidance C(2026)5252 (2026-07-27): public repo sharing generally not placing on market.
nodes.specifics: Dates: Art14 2026-09-11; Ch.IV notified bodies 2026-06-11; rest 2027-12-11. Annex I Part I(2)(a)-(m), Part II(1)-(8). L5 artifact: SECURITY.md + CVD policy + CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM per release + signed release provenance = steward-grade file set; a commercial distributor adds conformity assessment, 24h/72h/14d reporting.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Read via secondary reproduction of OJ text (EUR-Lex blocked); 'owes nothing' false if a legal-person entity sells support (then manufacturer). Guidance is draft.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Steward regime still requires documented policy; Art13(5) makes SBOM/CVD de facto mandatory for adoption.

nodes.title: Annex III classification risk: web server not listed, but WAF/firewall function could land in class II
nodes.summary: Class I lists OS, PKI, VPN, SIEM, NMS, IdM/PAM; class II lists firewalls/IDPS, hypervisors/container runtimes. Reverse proxy/web server not listed; a built-in WAF or microVM/container runtime feature could be argued into class II (third-party assessment unless the Art32(5) FOSS route with public tech docs permits module A).
nodes.specifics: Mitigation: label admission control as rate-limiting/policy, not 'firewall'; publish technical documentation to preserve the Art32(5) route.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Classification depends on implementing act; no ruling found.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Isolation/microVM features move toward hypervisor/container-runtime wording.

nodes.title: FIPS mode = exact validated aws-lc-fips-sys pin, approved mode, not 'fips feature on'
nodes.summary: Validated AWS-LC FIPS 3.1 (CMVP #5298 dynamic, #5314 static, Level 1, #5314 sunset 2031-06-04) corresponds to aws-lc-fips-sys 0.13.11 / aws-lc-rs 1.15.3 per explorer. aws-lc-rs 1.18.0 (2026-08-07) switched to AWS-LC-FIPS 4.0, only in MIP (Comment Resolution-Lab 2026-10-22); AWS-LC 5 Pending Review. Later 0.13.17 moves to v3.6.0 source, not necessarily byte-identical to the certificate. FIPS 140-2 certs moved to Historical 2026-09-21. Static builds Linux only; OS entropy not validated.
nodes.specifics: Cargo pin proposal: aws-lc-fips-sys = "=0.13.11"; aws-lc-rs = "=1.15.3" features=["fips"]. Approved mode per Security Policy 11.1 on a listed operational environment. Latest crates: aws-lc-fips-sys 0.14.3, aws-lc-rs 1.18.2.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Cannot claim 'FIPS validated' for 1.18.x/ML-DSA until a v4 cert issues.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Pin path exists today, so SC-13 is satisfiable without own validation.

nodes.title: Acceptance gate: assert FipsStatus::Certified at startup and in health endpoint
nodes.summary: rustls main (rustls-aws-lc-rs 0.24.0-dev.2) exposes ServerConfig::fips() -> rustls_pki_types::FipsStatus {Unvalidated|Pending|Certified{certificate}} (pki-types 1.15.1); 0.23.x (0.23.46) has only fips()->bool. Gate: in the fips build, startup aborts unless Certified (or bool true on 0.23); certificate id logged into audit log and /healthz; CI builds with and without the feature and asserts.
nodes.specifics: `aegis --fips-check` exits nonzero if provider not Certified; deny non-approved suites (no ChaCha20 in approved mode; ML-KEM hybrid only if module approved).
nodes.overclaim_risk: 0.24 is a dev release; API may shift.

nodes.title: COMPLIANCE_MAP: control -> mechanism -> evidence (NIST 800-53 r5 5.2.0 / FedRAMP KSI)
nodes.summary: Rows a server binary can natively satisfy: SC-13 FIPS-pinned aws-lc + FipsStatus gate; SC-8/8(1) TLS1.3-only listeners (KSI-SVC-SIN, KSI-CNA-MAT) with testssl/tlsfuzzer output; SC-23 session binding tests; SC-12 key rotation via systemd credentials + reloadable ResolvesServerCert (KSI-SVC-ASM); SI-7/SI-7(1)/SI-7(15) signed release + SLSA provenance + self-digest check (KSI-SVC-VRI); CM-7 default-deny config + systemd score <=1.4 (KSI-CMT-RMV); CM-2 config hash at boot; AU-2/3/12 event schema; AU-9(3)/AU-10/SI-7(7) Merkle tile log with signed checkpoints (KSI-MLA-LET); SA-15(13) logging syntax; SA-11/SR-2,3,5 cargo-vet/deny/audit + SBOM (KSI-SCR-MIT).
nodes.specifics: FedRAMP consolidated rules v2026.10.13.01; KSI mappings from the rules JSON. Evidence default = machine-readable explanation+verification+validation.
nodes.overclaim_risk: A binary satisfies mechanisms only; implementation statements remain the deployer's. Mapping of our mechanisms to KSIs is author-judged.
nodes.underclaim_risk: 20x machine-readable evidence favours this artifact style.

nodes.title: SSDF 1.2 IPD practice -> CI gate mapping
nodes.summary: SP 800-218 r1 IPD (2025-12-17; comments closed 2026-01-30; no final as of 2026-10-24) adds PO.6 and PS.4. Gates: PS.2.1 signed releases+hashes; PS.3.2 provenance; PW.6 hardened build flags/forbid unsafe; PW.8 fuzz+proptest+Kani; PW.9 secure-default config test; RV.1-3 cargo-audit/deny + CVD; PS.4.1 test all releases; PS.4.2 staged rollout; PS.4.3 anti-rollback (signed monotonic version); PS.4.4 fault-tolerant updater; PO.6.2 memory-safe languages and logging-format improvements.
nodes.specifics: v1.1 (2022-02) still final; build to 1.2 IPD labelled draft. EO 14306 basis.
nodes.underclaim_risk: PS.4.3 anti-rollback is new and implementable.

nodes.title: Audit-log format and invariant spec: C2SP tlog-tiles in Rust, single writer, signed checkpoints
nodes.summary: JSON-lines events (ts, seq, actor, action, object, outcome, req_id, config_hash, fips_status) hashed as RFC6962 leaves into a tlog-tiles tree (256x32B tiles; checkpoint = origin/size/root signed-note). Invariants: I1 append-only consistent checkpoints; I2 gapless seq = leaf index; I3 full tiles immutable; I4 checkpoint signed after tile fsync; I5 independent proof verification; I6 secrets never logged (typed redaction); I7 explicit log-failure policy (fail-closed for admin actions); optional witness cosignatures. Maps to AU-2/3/9(3)/10/12, SI-7(7), SA-15(13).
nodes.specifics: Reference impls Go only: Tessera v1.0.4 (2026-07-16; avoid 1.0.3), Trillian v1.8.0 (2026-09-21). Rust: tlog_tiles 0.2.0 (cloudflare/azul, 4.2k dl), sigsum 0.3.0. Test: Tessera POSIX personality / Go checker as conformance oracle; Kani/proptest for I1-I3.
nodes.overclaim_risk: No production-grade Rust tlog writer; tamper evidence needs an external witness/anchor.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Spec is small and stable (C2SP updated 2026-10-07).

nodes.title: systemd hardening: minimal 9.4 UNSAFE, caddy dist unit 8.8 EXPOSED, aegis baseline 1.4 OK
nodes.summary: systemd 255.4 Ubuntu, systemd-analyze security --offline=true: minimal unit 9.4; upstream Caddy unit 8.8; aegis-hardened.service 1.4 (72 checks pass). Runtime verified via transient unit with DynamicUser: HTTP 200 served, writes to /etc and /usr blocked, CapEff=0x400 only, RWX mmap denied under MemoryDenyWriteExecute (JIT incompatible, so a Wasmtime/Cranelift worker needs a separate unit with MDWX relaxed).
nodes.specifics: DynamicUser=yes, ProtectSystem=strict, NoNewPrivileges, CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE, RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_UNIX, SystemCallFilter=@system-service ~@privileged @resources, MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes, ProtectProc=invisible, KeyringMode=private, WatchdogSec=30. CI gate: systemd-analyze security --threshold=2 --offline. PrivateUsers=yes gives 1.2 but breaks <1024 bind.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Static exposure heuristic; runtime test used a python stand-in on one distro/systemd 255.

nodes.title: Single-binary ACME: instant-acme 0.8.5 preferred; rustls-acme 0.15.4 lacks FIPS and ARI
nodes.summary: instant-acme 0.8.5 (2026-02-24, Apache-2.0, 3.52M dl): RFC 9773 ARI, profiles, IP identifiers, EAB, key rollover, revocation, Pebble tests, fips feature via aws-lc-rs; P-256 account keys only; main 0.9.0 unreleased MSRV 1.88. rustls-acme 0.15.4 (2026-08-11, 823k dl): TLS-ALPN-01/HTTP-01 but no fips feature, no ARI seen. acme2/acme-lib stale.
nodes.specifics: Pin instant-acme =0.8.5 features fips; test against Pebble in CI; renew via ARI window; hot-swap cert through ResolvesServerCert.

nodes.title: No NIAP protection profile exists for web servers/reverse proxies/app gateways
nodes.summary: commoncriteria org lists application (PP_APP v1.4), tls package v1.0, vpngw, authserver, webbrowser, servervirtualization, crypto-catalog; none for web server or app gateway. Government path is FIPS 140-3 module use + FedRAMP/800-53 inheritance, not CC; PP_APP + TLS package nearest if CC demanded.
nodes.specifics: Checked 2026-10-24; NIAP PCL JS-only, not viewed.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Absence from GitHub org could miss a PP elsewhere.

nodes.title: FedRAMP 2026 consolidated rules: KSI groups mapped to 800-53; machine-readable evidence
nodes.summary: fedramp-consolidated-rules.json v2026.10.13.01 (launch 2026-06-24): KSI groups CED CMT CNA IAM INR MLA PIY RPL SCR SVC (10; explorer said 11, verifier corrected). Mappings: SVC-SIN->sc-13,8,8.1,23,28; SVC-VRI->si-7,7.1,7.15,au-9.3,sr-10/11; SVC-ASM->sc-12; MLA-LET->au-2,10,12,7,si-7.7; CMT-RMV->cm-2,cm-7. Phase 2 pilot 2025-11-18..2026-03.
nodes.specifics: Server project provides evidence-generating mechanisms; authorization belongs to the CSP.

nodes.title: Config validation (typed language) and secrets via systemd credentials
nodes.summary: CUE, Pkl (0.31.1; GOV.UK ADR 0022), or TOML+serde deny_unknown_fields with a Rust validator. For a single static binary, Rust-native typed parse (JSON Schema emitted for tooling) avoids a runtime dependency; CUE/Pkl as offline CI lint. Secrets via systemd LoadCredential(Encrypted) from $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY; rotate by new credential + reload with atomic ResolvesServerCert swap, logged (SC-12).
nodes.specifics: `aegis check-config` pure, exits nonzero, run in ExecStartPre.
